japanese-kana.swsh: ダイマックスした　ポケモンが くりだす　エスパータイプの　こうげき。 ５ターンのあいだ　サイコフィールドにする。

korean.swsh: 다이맥스한 포켓몬이 날리는 에스퍼타입의 공격. 5턴 동안 사이코필드로 만든다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 極巨化寶可夢 所使出的超能力屬性攻擊。 可在５回合內將腳下變成精神場地。

french.swsh: Une attaque de type Psy que seuls les Pokémon Dynamax peuvent utiliser. Crée un Champ Psychique qui dure cinq tours.

german.swsh: Eine Psycho-Attacke, die nur Dynamax-Pokémon einsetzen können. Erzeugt fünf Runden lang ein Psychofeld.

spanish.swsh: Ataque de tipo Psíquico ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea un campo psíquico durante cinco turnos.

italian.swsh: Un attacco di tipo Psico che può essere eseguito dai Pokémon dynamaxizzati. Per cinque turni il terreno entra nello stato di Campo Psichico.

english.swsh: This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for five turns.

japanese.swsh: ダイマックスした　ポケモンが 繰りだす　エスパータイプの　攻撃。 ５ターンの　間　サイコフィールドにする。

simplified-chinese.swsh: 极巨化宝可梦使出的超能力属性攻击。 可在５回合内将脚下变成精神场地。

latin-american-spanish.swsh: Ataque de tipo Psíquico ejecutado por un Pokémon Dinamax. Crea un campo psíquico durante cinco turnos.

effect.full: Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns.  Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain. All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0.  (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.)  Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×. If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.
effect.shortEffect: Protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and increases the power of their  Psychic moves by 50%.
